headline: Meta reportedly preparing smart glasses with no camera
summary: Two outlets report, both citing The Information, that Meta is preparing to launch smart glasses without a camera. They differ on how settled the launch is: one says Meta will soon unveil them, the other that it may be ready to. One outlet also ties the move to a privacy backlash and gives the codename Luna.
